pr_title: Fix bug for NQX index options
pr_body:
<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->
#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
Since NQX is based on 1/5 of the value of NDX (see https://www.nasdaq.com/solutions/nasdaq-100-index-options), when used with the `OptionFilterUniverse.Strikes()` filter, it returned an empty list of option chains. This was because the underlying price was never found among the option strike prices. Therefore, a new column in the SPDB was added containing the value by which the option's strike price must be scaled to be compared with the underlying price in the aforementioned scenarios.
#### Related Issue
<!--- This project only accepts pull requests related to open issues -->
<!--- If suggesting a new feature or change, please discuss it in an issue first -->
<!--- If fixing a bug, there should be an issue describing it with steps to reproduce -->
<!--- Please link to the issue here: -->
Closes #7801 
#### Motivation and Context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
With this change users will get option chains for NQX when using the filter `OptionFilterUniverse.Strikes()`
#### Requires Documentation Change
<!--- Please indicate if these changes will require updates to documentation, and if so, specify what changes are required -->
N/A
#### How Has This Been Tested?
<!--- Please describe in detail how you tested your changes. -->
<!--- Include details of your testing environment, and the tests you ran to -->
<!--- see how your change affects other areas of the code, etc. -->
I created a regression algorithm that gets 2 index option(NQX) chains while using the filter `OptionFilterUniverse.Strikes()`. Then it waits until both option contracts expire, so that it can finally assert that one of them expires ITM and the other one OTM.

issue_context.title: "NQX" index option is not accessible through slice object.
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
We should get OptionChains from the slice object for "NQX" -> weekly contracts for the underlying index "NDX"
Reference: https://www.quantconnect.com/datasets/algoseek-us-index-options

#### Actual Behavior
We do not get OptionChains for "NQX" for all timeframes and for all resolutions but we get data using `OptionChainProvider.GetOptionContractList(option.Symbol, time)`. 
Note: We get data for all other index options using both slice object and OptionChainProvider.GetOptionContractList()

#### Potential Solution
We have the data which is confirmed by data from `OptionChainProvider.GetOptionContractList(option.Symbol, time)`. Could be a mapping issue for "NQX".

#### Reproducing the Problem
Attaching the [backtest](https://www.quantconnect.com/terminal/processCache/?request=embedded_backtest_f2290a8aaff3cad293a649771d34a12e.html) for reference.

![image](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/assets/62750665/82fd4cfd-7dd3-4f6e-9736-25e493556b9d)
data.OptionChains.get() for "NQX" is always empty.

Data for NQX is available when we use:
```
self = QuantBook()
index_symbol = self.AddIndex("NDX").Symbol
option = self.AddIndexOption(index_symbol, "NQX")
option.SetFilter(lambda universe: universe.IncludeWeeklys().Strikes(-2, 2).Expiration(0, 30))
time = datetime(2023, 6, 1)
symbols = self.OptionChainProvider.GetOptionContractList(option.Symbol, time)
self.History(symbols[:5], time, time+timedelta(2), Resolution.Daily, fillForward=False)
```
![image](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/assets/62750665/15cbc898-a8a9-4bd3-bb78-8ee04c0364ed)
